_note: Fix for Tracker 4647955 finding 4: loner greet 'Just me' reply varies by the cat's traits. Same slot design as presence/openers: first matching `when` wins, last entry is the default. Tokens: {catName} only.

variants.text: “Just me,” you say. {catName}'s lip lifts off one saber. “Good. Fewer of you to watch.” The look that follows isn't friendly, but it isn't a threat either.
“Just me,” you say. {catName}'s whole face eases. “Me too. It's been a long while since anyone answered back.”
“Just me,” you say. {catName} only grunts, already half-turned away, as if that settles something.
“Just me,” you say. {catName}'s head tilts. “By choice, or did someone send you off?” No answer is waited for, but {catName} doesn't leave either.
“Just me,” you say. {catName} checks the brush behind you anyway, twice, before letting the hackles settle.
“Just me,” you say. {catName} looks past you one more time, then gives a short nod. “Then it's two of us on one trail. That'll do.”
